items.exampleEn: After two years, she finally got a permanent job.
items.exampleZh: 兩年後，她終於找到一份正職工作。

items.exampleEn: We occasionally eat out on weekends.
items.exampleZh: 我們週末偶爾會在外面吃飯。

items.exampleEn: Our office is on the fifth floor.
Prices in this city are constantly changing.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市的物價不斷在變動。

items.exampleEn: Initially, I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
items.exampleZh: 一開始我不喜歡這座城市，但現在很愛它。

items.exampleEn: The newly opened cafe is always full.
items.exampleZh: 那家新開的咖啡店總是客滿。

items.exampleEn: The frequency of his visits has dropped this year.
items.exampleZh: 他今年來訪的次數變少了。

items.exampleEn: Please put these pictures in the right sequence.
items.exampleZh: 請把這些圖片按照正確的順序排好。

items.sentenceEn: The newly built library opens on the fifth of June.
items.sentenceZh: 新蓋好的圖書館在六月五日開放。

items.audioEn: My sister used to have a part-time job, but now she has a permanent one at a bank.
items.audioZh: 我的姊妹以前做兼職工作，但現在她在一家銀行有正職工作。
items.questionZh: 說話者的姊妹現在做什麼工作？
options: A permanent job at a bank
A part-time job at a bank
A part-time job at a school

items.sentenceEn: He constantly checks his email during dinner.
items.sentenceZh: 他吃晚餐時不停地查看電子郵件。

items.sentenceEn: What is the frequency of the buses to the airport?
items.sentenceZh: 往機場的公車多久一班？

items.stemEn: I don't go to the movies often; I go only ____.
items.stemZh: 我不常去看電影，只是偶爾去。

items.stemEn: Please read the steps in the correct ____, from one to five.
items.stemZh: 請按照正確的順序閱讀這些步驟，從一到五。

items.passageEn: In March, Kelly started a newly created job at a shoe company. Initially, it was only a six-month job, but in her fifth month, the company made it permanent. Her job is to plan the sequence of steps for making each shoe. She constantly checks how fast the machines work, and occasionally she has to fix small problems. She enjoys the work because she learns something new every day.
items.passageZh: 三月時，Kelly 在一家鞋子公司開始一份新設立的工作。一開始那只是一份六個月的工作，但到了第五個月，公司把它改成正職。她的工作是規劃做每一雙鞋的步驟順序。她不斷檢查機器運作的速度，偶爾也得處理一些小問題。她喜歡這份工作，因為每天都學到新東西。

questions.questionZh: Kelly 的工作在什麼時候變成正職？
Kelly 的工作內容是什麼？
options: 到各地銷售公司的鞋子
規劃做鞋子的步驟順序

items.promptZh: 這家店一開始只賣咖啡。
referenceEn: Initially, the shop only sold coffee.
The shop sold only coffee initially.
rubricZh: initially 表示「起初、一開始」，可放在句首、句尾等位置
過去的事用過去式（例如 sold）
only 可放在動詞前或受詞前（例如 only sold coffee、sold only coffee）

items.promptZh: 昨晚，隔壁的狗一直不停地叫。
referenceEn: Last night, the dog next door barked constantly.
The dog next door was barking constantly last night.
rubricZh: 用 constantly 表示「不停地」（例如 barked constantly；寫 kept barking 也正確）
時態配合「昨晚」（例如 barked、was barking 等）
